name: snes9xgit/snes9x
description: A portable Super Nintendo Entertainment System emulator available across Windows, Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, and gaming consoles. Includes both a standalone emulator and a libretro core.
score_rationale: A long-standing SNES emulator with 3.1k stars that remains a widely used reference implementation and libretro core.
summary: Established SNES emulator with libretro core support
